'''Yestan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], Yestan managed a small shop, also teaching the knowledge of [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] construction to others.
